rv.q: Now at the Signature, it returns after a 2023 engagement at 59E59, which I missed. Montano was nominated for Outstanding Solo Performance awards by both the Drama Desk and Outer Critics Circle. Dressed in the same tight jeans and blue denim shirt throughout, Montano, who is in his mid-60s, is as trim and fit as someone at least 15 years younger.
Montano is an ingratiating and thoroughly engaging storyteller.
Small lifts you into the saddle and challenges you to hang on for a bumpy but exhilarating ride.

cn.t: Robert Montano delivers a tour-de-force performance in this whip-smart solo show about growing up short on Long Island, impressing critics with its polished integration of dance, music, and storytelling into a confident coming-of-age tale.
